newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,088 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,088 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,088 contracts compared with 2,163 overnight Monday.
There were 132 wheat, 1,182 corn, 686 soybean, six soymeal, 13 soyoil, one oat, 50 corn calls, four corn puts, 12 soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to 1/4 cent higher, corn was 1-3/4 to 1/4 cent higher and soybeans were one cent lower to three cents higher.
